Ramen Cabbage Salad
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 4, 2009 - 1:01am

Ingredients




1/2 cup chopped onion
1/2 cabbage, cubed
1 pkg. Ramen noodles, broken up

Preparation

1 Brown in small amount of oil: 2 tbsp. sesame seeds 2 Add: 3 tsp. vinegar 1/2 c. oil Seasoning from Ramen noodles 3 Mix dressing ingredients separately and add just before serving. Even refrigerated left overs are good.
